displayedInputs.question: A sequence of numbers is 3, 6, 9, 12. Following the rule of adding 3 each time, what comes after 12? Calculate: \(12+3=?\)
A sequence of numbers is 30, 25, 20, 15. Following the rule of subtracting 5 each time, what comes after 15? Calculate: \(15-5=?\)
How much time does the minute hand take to complete one full turn around a clock face?
How many seconds are in 2 minutes?
How many seconds are in 3 minutes?
How many minutes are in 2 hours?
How many seconds are in 4 minutes?
A lesson lasts 40 minutes, and the break lasts 10 minutes. How many minutes pass in total from the start of the lesson until the break after the end-of-lesson bell is over? Calculate: \(40+10=?\)
A movie starts at 7:15 and ends at 7:50. How many minutes does it last? Calculate: \(50-15=?\)
A run starts at 3:40 and ends at exactly 4 o'clock. How many minutes does the run last? Calculate: \(60-40=?\)
One box contains 180 books, and another contains 140 books. How many books are in the 2 boxes altogether? Calculate: \(180+140=?\)
A library has 730 books, and 280 books are borrowed. How many books remain? Calculate: \(730-280=?\)
What is the purpose of estimation?

choices.A: To quickly find an approximate amount
choices.B: To always calculate the exact result
choices.C: To be used only for subtraction

displayedInputs.question: An item of clothing costs 198 yuan, and a hat costs 102 yuan. About how many yuan do they cost altogether? Treat the prices as 200 yuan and 100 yuan to calculate. Calculate: \(200+100=?\)

A nail is 2 centimeters long, and another is 15 millimeters long. Which is longer? First convert 2 centimeters to millimeters, then compare. How many millimeters are 2 centimeters? Calculate: \(2\times10=?\)
A classroom desk is about 7 decimeters high. How many centimeters are 7 decimeters? Calculate: \(7\times10=\)?

The distance from the school to the park is 2 kilometers, and from the park to the library is another 1 kilometer. How many kilometers is it in total from the school to the library? Calculate: \(2+1=\)?
